cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: Things Around Us.

words.en: My alarm clock rings at seven.
words.scene: A round red alarm clock on a bedside table, ringing with two little bells on top and a hammer hitting them.
more: Lily sets her alarm clock for school.
Dad's alarm clock is very loud.

words.en: Grandma shows us her photo album.
words.sz: 奶奶给我们看她的相册。
words.scene: Grandma sitting in an armchair, holding an open photo album on her lap, pointing at a picture of Lily and Tom.
more: Sam puts his stamps in the album.
Sam 把邮票放进集邮册。

words.scene: Tom holding the string of a big shiny red helium balloon that is floating up towards the ceiling.

words.en: Dad puts a new battery in.
words.scene: Dad opening the back of a TV remote control and putting in two small cylindrical batteries.
more: The toy car needs a battery.
My toy car needs a new battery.
我的玩具车需要换新电池了。

words.scene: Lily standing in front of a bathroom mirror, holding a toothbrush to her mouth with foam on it.
more: Max needs a brush for his fur.
Max 需要一把刷子梳毛。

words.en: The cups are in the cabinet.
words.scene: A white kitchen wall cabinet with glass doors, showing plates and cups inside neatly arranged on shelves.
A view looking up at a white ceiling with a spinning ceiling fan in the centre and a light bulb hanging down.
more: There is a spider on the ceiling.
The light is on the ceiling.

words.en: My coat is in the closet.
words.scene: An open built-in bedroom closet with clothes hanging on rails and shoes on a shelf below.
more: Lily puts her dress in the closet.
Tom is behind the closet door.

words.scene: Lily sitting on the floor, holding a cloth doll with black hair and a pink dress in her arms.

words.en: Put your work in the folder.
words.sz: 把你的作业放进文件夹。
words.scene: A blue plastic file folder standing upright on a desk, containing several sheets of paper.
more: Lily 在她的文件夹上写‘美术’。

words.scene: Close-up of Max the puppy's head and shoulders, showing his fluffy, shiny brown coat.
Sam sitting on a bus, wearing large over-ear black headphones, eyes closed, enjoying music.
Tom running in a grassy field, holding the string of a diamond-shaped red and yellow kite flying high in the sky.
more: The kite is up in the tree.

words.scene: Lily standing on a small stage in school, holding a black handheld microphone close to her mouth.

words.en: Dad drinks tea from a mug.
words.scene: A large ceramic mug with a handle, filled with hot tea and steam rising up, sitting on a wooden table.
A close-up of a hand holding a blue ballpoint pen, writing on a piece of white paper.
more: Do you have a red pen?

words.scene: A yellow wooden pencil with a black tip and a pink rubber at the end, lying on a sketchbook.
An open zip-up fabric pencil case on a desk, with pencils and a ruler inside.
more: Lily puts pens in her pencil case.

words.scene: A small glass bottle of perfume with a gold cap on a dressing table, next to some flowers.

words.en: This bottle is made of plastic.
words.scene: A close-up of a clear, empty plastic water bottle with a blue cap, sitting on a wooden table.
more: We use plastic bags for shopping.

words.en: Lily draws a poster for the school play.
words.sz: Lily 为学校的演出画了一张海报。
words.scene: A colourful, hand-drawn poster on a classroom wall showing a cat and a star, pinned with four red pins.
more: There is a new film poster in the shop window.
商店橱窗里有一张新电影海报。
We put up posters for the party.

words.scene: Tom sitting on the carpet, carefully placing the last piece of a 20-piece puzzle showing a farm scene.
more: Can you help me with this puzzle?
你能帮我做这个拼图吗？

words.en: Lily cuts the paper with scissors.
words.scene: A pair of child-safe scissors with blue handles cutting a zigzag line on a sheet of red paper.
more: Be careful with the scissors, Tom!

words.en: Sam rides his scooter to school.
words.scene: A boy riding a kick scooter on a paved path, one foot on the deck and the other pushing off the ground.
more: I like my new blue scooter.
我喜欢我的新蓝色滑板车。
Be careful when you ride your scooter.

words.scene: A pink bottle of shampoo with a white cap next to a yellow rubber duck in a bathtub full of bubbles.
more: Tom washes his hair with shampoo.
The shampoo is sweet and good.

words.scene: Dad standing at a bed, shaking out a big clean white bed sheet in the air above the mattress, the sheet billowing like a sail.
more: Write your name on this sheet of paper.
在这张纸上写下你的名字。
The blue sheet is soft and warm.
蓝色的床单柔软又暖和。

words.en: Tom eats soup with a spoon.
words.scene: A silver metal spoon resting in a bowl of yellow corn soup, steam rising gently.
more: Use a spoon for the ice cream.
There is a big wooden spoon on the table.

words.en: Mum puts a stamp on the letter.
words.sz: 妈妈在信上贴了一张邮票。
words.scene: A small rectangular postage stamp with a picture of a red double-decker bus, being held by tweezers over an envelope.
more: I collect old stamps in my book.
This stamp has a bird on it.

words.en: Lily goes up the stairs to her room.
words.sz: Lily 上楼梯去她的房间。
words.scene: A wooden staircase with a white handrail, Lily walking up it holding onto the rail.
more: Our house has two flights of stairs.

words.en: We sit at the table for dinner.
words.scene: A rectangular wooden dining table with four chairs, a vase of flowers in the centre.
more: Put your homework on the table.
The glass is on the small round table.

words.en: Tom plays with his favourite toy.
words.sz: Tom 玩他最喜欢的玩具。
words.scene: A soft brown teddy bear sitting on a shelf next to a red toy car and a blue block.
more: This is my new toy train.
Put your toys in the box, please.

words.en: Lily practises the violin every day.
words.scene: A girl holding a brown violin under her chin and playing it with a bow, music stand in front of her.
more: My uncle plays the violin in a band.
我叔叔在一个乐队里拉小提琴。

words.en: There is a picture on the wall.
words.scene: Lily standing on a small stool, hanging a framed picture of a red boat on a bright blue bedroom wall, the whole wall clearly visible.
more: Don't draw on the wall, Tom!
The garden wall is high and strong.

words.en: Mum puts her coat in the wardrobe.
words.sz: 妈妈把外套放进衣柜里。
words.scene: A tall wooden wardrobe with two doors, one slightly open showing hangers with shirts and a dress inside.
more: My shoes are on the bottom of the wardrobe.
The wardrobe is in the bedroom.

words.en: Lily writes a letter on paper.
words.scene: A stack of white sheets of paper with one sheet having a pencil sketch of a cat on it.
more: This bag is made of brown paper.
这个袋子是棕色纸做的。

words.en: The bike is made of metal.
words.scene: A close-up of a shiny silver metal bicycle handlebar and brake lever, reflecting light.
more: This spoon is made of metal.
This metal box is very strong.

words.en: Dad has a brown leather bag.
words.scene: Dad holding a smooth dark brown leather bag with a shiny buckle, Lily touching the soft leather with one hand.
more: These shoes are made of leather.
The leather sofa is soft and comfortable.

words.scene: A shiny gold trophy cup with two handles, standing on a shelf in the living room.
more: The ring is made of real gold.

words.en: Lily puts her stuff in the box.
words.sz: Lily 把她的东西放进盒子里。
words.scene: Lily kneeling on the bedroom floor, putting toys and books into a big open storage box.
more: I don't need that old stuff.

words.scene: Tom holding a strange, colourful toy with big curious eyes, looking at it closely.
more: Mum bought a new thing for the kitchen.
妈妈给厨房买了一个新东西。

words.en: We need sports equipment for games.
words.sz: 我们比赛需要体育器材。
words.scene: A school sports room with balls, bats, nets and hoops on shelves.
more: The men bring big equipment to fix the road.
工人们带来大型设备修路。

words.scene: Sam sitting at a desk, carefully painting a small white model airplane.
more: Lily 做了一个房子模型。
The model car is very fast.

words.scene: A close-up of a single bright green bean on a white plate, with other beans in the background.
more: I like brown beans in soup.

words.sz: 妈妈烤了一块巧克力曲奇。
words.scene: A golden-brown cookie with dark chocolate chips sitting on a cooling rack in a sunny kitchen.
more: This cookie is sweet and good.

words.scene: A ripe, bright orange-yellow mango resting on a wooden table next to a glass of juice.
A red paper container filled with golden, crispy French fries on a table in a cafe.
more: French fries are hot and nice.

words.en: We have fast food on Saturday.
words.scene: A burger, fries and a drink sitting on a tray on a table in a bright restaurant.
more: Fast food is quick to eat.
Mum says fast food is not healthy.

words.scene: A family sitting around a table at night, bowls of warm soup in front of them, lamp light glowing.
An open book on a kitchen counter showing pictures of ingredients, Mum looking at it while mixing flour.
Fresh vegetables like carrots, onions and peppers arranged neatly on a cutting board.
more: We need all the ingredients for pizza.
我们需要做披萨的所有食材。

words.scene: Lily using a ruler to draw a long, straight black line on a piece of white paper.
more: We wait in a long line for the bus.
我们排长队等公共汽车。

words.scene: Tom holding a crayon, drawing a large blue circle on the ground in a playground.
more: We sit in a circle for story time.
我们围坐成一圈听故事。

words.scene: A zebra standing in the grass, its body covered in bold black and white stripes.
more: Mum wears a shirt with blue stripes.
妈妈穿一件蓝色条纹衬衫。
I like the red stripes on my socks.
我喜欢我袜子上的红色条纹。

words.en: The car makes a loud noise.
words.sz: 那辆车发出很大的噪音。
words.scene: A red car driving past, with sound waves drawn coming from the engine/exhaust, Lily covering her ears slightly.
more: 我听到一个奇怪的响声。

words.scene: Mum sitting at a dressing table, applying lipstick, with various makeup items like brushes and powder visible.

words.en: We have a set of cups.
words.scene: Four matching colourful cups lined up neatly on a shelf in the kitchen.
more: Sam has a new set of pens.
